integrity: The exact complexity transfer uses the established equality between the schematic fragment of propositional inquisitive logic and Medvedev logic, together with the 2026 Pi-0-1 completeness theorem for Medvedev logic. Parallel undecidability work was treated as corroborating rather than as evidence for the sharper classification.
scientific_limitations: The result transfers an exact complexity classification through an established equality of logics; it is not a new undecidability reduction.
The theorem concerns schematic theoremhood for propositional inquisitive logics over a countably infinite variable set, not first-order inquisitive logic or arbitrary premise consequence.
The family-wide extension is only for the intermediate inquisitive logics whose schematic fragment is established to be Medvedev logic.
title: Schematic validity of \(\mathrm{InqB}\) is \(\Pi^0_1\)-complete
